description: The bar chart illustrates the performance comparison between two models, MMAU and MMAR, across three distinct audio reasoning tasks: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen2.5-Omni, with accuracy measured as a percentage on the vertical axis ranging from 0% to 70% in increments of 10%. The horizontal axis lists the three tasks, each represented by a pair of adjacent bars — blue for MMAU and purple for MMAR — as indicated in the legend in the upper left corner. In the Qwen2-Audio-Instruct task, MMAU achieves approximately 48% accuracy while MMAR reaches about 30%. For Audio-Reasoner, MMAU performs at roughly 61% accuracy compared to MMAR’s ~36%. In the Qwen2.5-Omni task, MMAU attains approximately 64% accuracy, whereas MMAR scores around 56%. Across all three tasks, MMAU consistently outperforms MMAR, with the largest performance gap observed in the Audio-Reasoner task and the smallest in Qwen2.5-Omni. The bars are grouped by task, with no sorting applied, and all bars are rendered with solid fills and no additional annotations or error bars.
